answer: A newcomer earns standing only as a vine: each stranger it helps must pass the help on to a different stranger, growing one public chain link by link, each link a vertex in a mirrored graph anyone can inspect. Privileges rise only as the vine lengthens toward new, unrelated people; a chain that dead-ends withers. A Sybil farm betrays itself because its vines all bend back to the same few vertices — the same accounts helping each other in a closed loop — while honest vines wander outward. Stalled chains must earn a new link alone, from outside the old circle, before transacting again.
